n: 30" Electric Range with 15+ Ways To Cook
hl: Make healthier and delicious meals for your entire family - right in your oven.
With Slow Cook, your food cooks slowly and at a lower temperature (as low as 100° F), allowing you to lock in moisture and flavor without over or undercooking your food.
Get over 15 ways to cook - Total Convection powers cooking modes like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Air Sous Vide, Bread Proof, Dehydrate and more!
Eliminates time wasted waiting on your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to meal time, in no time.
Designed to handle all of your cooking needs with a powerful 3,200 Watt EvenTemp® Element and convenient Bridge Element.
Monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.
